property_summary: For every callee address that reverts on receive/fallback, C.forward forwards that failure by reverting (so calls to forward revert), whereas the mutant negates the success flag and will NOT revert when the callee itself reverts — thus the reference always causes forward to revert for a reverting callee, but the mutant sometimes returns successfully.
change_summary: Invert the call success boolean by negating _s before require, causing forward to revert when the callee call succeeds and continue when it fails (alternate syntax: assign negated value).
